name: Bent Blade
description: A steel blade bent into an S, which keeps one singing note where its curve turns, and can pass it to a second place and back.

params.name: Exciter
params.description: What sounds the blade. A bow and a breath hold the note for as long as the key is down; a mallet and a thumb start it and let it ring. Heard from the next note.

params.name: Bend
params.description: How deeply the blade is bent. A shallow bend keeps one short note among the clang of plain steel; a deep one keeps many notes, and keeps them long.

params.name: Well Width
params.description: How far apart the trapped notes lie. A narrow curve sets them an octave and more apart; a wide one crowds them close above the note.

params.name: Concord
params.description: Draws the upper trapped notes from their own places to the nearest fifths, fourths and octaves. Low is metal as it comes; high sits in any chord.

params.name: Second Well
params.description: A second bend that trades the sound with the first: none, one at the same note, one a fifth above with a low tone under both, or one an octave below. Next note.

params.name: Far Well
params.description: How loudly the second bend is heard. With none the note dips and returns as its sound goes away and comes back; with all of it the first bend steps behind.

params.name: Tunnel
params.description: How often the sound passes to the second bend and back. Slow is a tide, fast is a shiver that splits every note in two. Higher keys and notes go faster.

params.name: Pressure
params.description: How hard the bow presses, the mallet is, the thumb snaps or the breath blows. Light is a pure whistle; heavy is louder and brings out a reedy edge.

params.name: Rasp
params.description: The grain of the touch: rosin under the bow, felt on the mallet, skin on the thumb, air in the breath. It also makes the note waver.

params.name: Swell
params.description: How long a bowed or blown note takes to reach its level. For a mallet or a thumb it softens the blow.

params.name: Leak
params.description: How quickly the trapped sound escapes into plain steel, its upper notes first. Little rings on for many seconds; much leaves a short, dry, darker note.

params.name: Damp
params.description: What letting go of the key does. At the bottom the blade rings on as it likes; at the top a hand stops it at once.

params.name: Steel
params.description: The plain steel outside the bend: the clang of a blow, and the shimmering resonances that the bow's grain wakes.

params.name: Edge
params.description: How bright the blade is, from a dark hum to a bright ring. It lifts the upper trapped notes, the bow's edge and the steel together.

params.name: Tremble
params.description: How far the player's knee shakes the blade: pitch, colour and place move together. A struck blade shakes most from the blow.

params.name: Rate
params.description: How fast the blade is shaken.

params.name: Wander
params.description: How unsteady the hands are: the speed and the pressure of the bow and the place of the bend drift slowly, each key by itself, and a breath comes in gusts.

params.name: Glide
params.description: How long a note takes to slide to its pitch. At the bottom it is there at once. A chord that opens from one takes longer.

params.name: Glide Law
params.description: Where slides start: the note played just before, one key after another; the nearest note sounding; or one note that a whole chord opens out of and closes to again.

params.name: Width
params.description: How far apart the two bends, the keys and the steel are placed between left and right.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Overall output level of the instrument.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. Waves in a thin blade whose curvature changes sign are trapped where it does; the places of the trapped notes are the levels of the well an evenly growing curvature makes. A mode is a rotating complex one-pole, as in modal-bells; two wells are the two split modes of tunnelling. Levels are voiced by measurement.
